title: Grandmother's Punjabi Kitchen
narration: You step into the warm kitchen, greeted by the scent of fresh rotis and chai.
describe: In front of you, your grandmother sits near a mud hearth making rotis on a tawa, with a window framing the neem tree outside. On your right, your grandfather sits on a woven charpai by the open doorway drinking his tea, beside a playing radio. Behind you are stacked sacks of wheat and a clean brick floor. I added recessed shelves of stainless steel canisters on your left and clay pots against the wall.

spec.memory: My grandmother's kitchen in Punjab, on a winter evening. She's making rotis on the tawa, the radio is playing old songs, and there's a window with a neem tree outside. My grandfather is sitting on a charpai near the door, drinking chai. Behind me was a steel almirah and a calendar with a picture of the Golden Temple.
spec.front_prompt: Looking straight ahead in the warm, modest Punjabi kitchen, the far left wall holds an open recessed shelf lined with steel spice containers, leading towards the center where a low brick chulha burns with steady embers beneath a seasoned black iron tawa. A grandmother in a simple floral salwar kameez sits on a low wooden pirhi, rolling soft wheat dough from a large brass parat and pressing puffing rotis onto the griddle. Above and slightly to the right of her cooking space, a rectangular wooden window looks out onto the darkening winter dusk, revealing the silhouette of an old neem tree outside against a cold purplish-blue sky, framed by softly soot-stained lime-washed walls.
spec.back_prompt: Behind the center of the room, a textured, lime-plastered wall shows gentle signs of age and wear under the dim ceiling bulb. In the far corner leans a traditional jharoo grass broom beside neatly stacked burlap sacks filled with winter provisions like wheat grain and potatoes. A pair of iron wall pegs holds a folded brown wool lohi shawl, while below, the floor is laid with worn, unglazed red clay bricks swept meticulously clean, untouched by any occupants. Behind me was a steel almirah and a calendar with a picture of the Golden Temple.
spec.sound_prompt: Muffled vintage radio melodies play with gentle analog static, layered beneath the rhythmic patting of flatbread dough, the dry sizzle of a hot tawa, and the faint crackle of burning wood. Behind me was a steel almirah and a calendar with a picture of the Golden Temple.
